FORM.notes: source note: lasvi 就是 salvi

S.FORM: au aiza tu tas tu hanian macingmut a mazasia tu munghuhuma tu bunun a kudiip siza mas isaicia tu sinsusuaz siukakuun tu sia lasvicia.
S.PHON: au aiða tu tas tu [x|χ]anian maʨiŋmut a maðaɕia tu muŋ[x|χ]u[x|χ]uma tu bunun a kudiip ɕiða mas isaiʨia tu ɕinsusuað ɕiukakuun tu ɕia [l|ɬ]asviʨia
S.FORM: au aiza tu tas tu hanian macingmut a mazasia tu munghuhuma tu bunun a kudiip siza mas isaicia tu sinsusuaz siukakuun tu sia lasvicia.
S.PHON: au aiða tu tas tu [x|χ]anian maʨiŋmut a maðaɕia tu muŋ[x|χ]u[x|χ]uma tu bunun a kudiip ɕiða mas isaiʨia tu ɕinsusuað ɕiukakuun tu ɕia [l|ɬ]asviʨia
S.TRANSL: 有一天,有一個農夫去摘取他所種的梨子.
One day, a farmer went to collect the pears he had planted.

S.FORM: a tancini saia ah maupacia tu siza mas isaicia tu siukaku.
S.PHON: a tanʨini saia a[x|χ] maupaʨia tu ɕiða mas isaiʨia tu ɕiukaku
S.FORM: a tancini saia ah maupacia tu siza mas isaicia tu siukaku.
S.PHON: a tanʨini saia a[x|χ] maupaʨia tu ɕiða mas isaiʨia tu ɕiukaku
S.TRANSL: 他自己一個人去收穫的.
He went to harvest them by himself.

S.FORM: aupa kudadaza sia lukis matapul.
S.PHON: aupa kudadaða ɕia [l|ɬ]ukis matapu[l|ɬ]
S.FORM: aupa kudadaza sia lukis matapul.
S.PHON: aupa kudadaða ɕia [l|ɬ]ukis matapu[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: 他就那樣一個人上去採集並拿著.
He went up to collect and took the harvest like that.

S.FORM: an miliskin saia tu pisialun saicia mapinauaz.
S.PHON: an mi[l|ɬ]iskin saia tu piɕia[l|ɬ]un saiʨia mapinauað
S.FORM: an miliskin saia tu pisialun saicia mapinauaz.
S.PHON: an mi[l|ɬ]iskin saia tu piɕia[l|ɬ]un saiʨia mapinauað
S.TRANSL: 他要好好的整理漂亮的
He thought, he wanted to arrange them nicely.

S.FORM: mahaishais mazasia tu makuang.
S.PHON: ma[x|χ]ais[x|χ]ais maðaɕia tu makuaŋ
S.FORM: mahaishais mazasia tu makuang.
S.PHON: ma[x|χ]ais[x|χ]ais maðaɕia tu makuaŋ
S.TRANSL: 他把不好看的擦乾淨變好看.
He wiped the dust off to make those harvests better.

S.FORM: aizin tu dusa tu kalala maza siniza.
S.PHON: aiðin tu dusa tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a maða ɕiniða
S.FORM: aizin tu dusa tu kalala maza siniza.
S.PHON: aiðin tu dusa tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a maða ɕiniða
S.TRANSL: 已經摘了兩籃了.
There were two basket of the collected ones.

S.FORM: niiang kanahtungan siza a muhnaang saia kudadaza sia lukiscia.
S.PHON: niiaŋ kana[x|χ]tuŋan ɕiða a mu[x|χ]naaŋ saia kudadaða ɕia [l|ɬ]ukisʨia
S.FORM: niiang kanahtungan siza a muhnaang saia kudadaza sia lukiscia.
S.PHON: niiaŋ kana[x|χ]tuŋan ɕiða a mu[x|χ]naaŋ saia kudadaða ɕia [l|ɬ]ukisʨia
S.TRANSL: 還沒結束,他還要再到樹上.
It was not over yet; he climbed up the tree again.

S.FORM: nasiza mas lasvicin.
S.PHON: naɕiða mas [l|ɬ]asviʨin
S.FORM: nasiza mas lasvicin.
S.PHON: naɕiða mas [l|ɬ]asviʨin
S.TRANSL: 要採梨子.
He wanted to pluck the pears.

FORM.notes: source note: tang- < tan- walk。tangkakaun 找食物吃。tangkakaun-an 放牧的場地。

S.FORM: aiza tu tacini bunun maupacia amin tu macingmut anghaib sadu mas isaicia tu sinkuzakuzacin madas mas sidi a mapatangkakaun mas sidicia.
S.PHON: aiða tu taʨini bunun maupaʨia amin tu maʨiŋmut aŋ[x|χ]aib sadu mas isaiʨia tu ɕinkuðakuðaʨin madas mas ɕidi a mapataŋkakaun mas ɕidiʨia
S.FORM: aiza tu tacini bunun maupacia amin tu macingmut anghaib sadu mas isaicia tu sinkuzakuzacin madas mas sidi a mapatangkakaun mas sidicia.
S.PHON: aiða tu taʨini bunun maupaʨia amin tu maʨiŋmut aŋ[x|χ]aib sadu mas isaiʨia tu ɕinkuðakuðaʨin madas mas ɕidi a mapataŋkakaun mas ɕidiʨia
S.TRANSL: 有一個人也一樣早,帶著山羊經過看到他所做的,讓山羊找食物吃.
There was also another person passing with a goat in the early morning. He let the goat find food.

W.TRANSL: 工焦<完成貌>工作=近距.斜格

S.FORM: aupa madaingin a lasvia minlukisdaingazin hai talpataz mais nasiza.
S.PHON: aupa madaiŋin a [l|ɬ]asvia min[l|ɬ]ukisdaiŋaðin [x|χ]ai ta[l|ɬ]patað mais naɕiða
S.FORM: aupa madaingin a lasvia minlukisdaingazin hai talpataz mais nasiza.
S.PHON: aupa madaiŋin a [l|ɬ]asvia min[l|ɬ]ukisdaiŋaðin [x|χ]ai ta[l|ɬ]patað mais naɕiða
S.TRANSL: 樹變大了,很難採.
The tree grew so big that it was hard to collect.

S.FORM: at aiza uvaaz maupacia tuntanpu amin aupa.
S.PHON: at aiða uvaað maupaʨia tuntanpu amin aupa
S.FORM: at aiza uvaaz maupacia tuntanpu amin aupa.
S.PHON: at aiða uvaað maupaʨia tuntanpu amin aupa
S.TRANSL: 然後有一個孩子也那樣騎著單車.
Then there was a kid riding a bike like that.

S.FORM: ah matus'in.
S.PHON: a[x|χ] matusʔin
S.FORM: ah matus'in.
S.PHON: a[x|χ] matusʔin
S.TRANSL: 天亮了.
It became dawn.

FORM.notes: source note: pa < aupa必經之路

S.FORM: nii tu haipun tu uvaazan hai namasikua mai'aupa amin sia dangian naicia pa tasa daan lahaiban.
S.PHON: nii tu [x|χ]aipun tu uvaaðan [x|χ]ai namaɕikua maiʔaupa amin ɕia daŋian naiʨia pa tasa daan [l|ɬ]a[x|χ]aiban
S.FORM: nii tu haipun tu uvaazan hai namasikua mai'aupa amin sia dangian naicia pa tasa daan lahaiban.
S.PHON: nii tu [x|χ]aipun tu uvaaðan [x|χ]ai namaɕikua maiʔaupa amin ɕia daŋian naiʨia pa tasa daan [l|ɬ]a[x|χ]aiban
S.TRANSL: 不知道這孩子要去哪裡.他也往他們在的地方因為只有一條路經過.
No one knew where the kid was going to. He went toward where they were because there was only a way.

FORM.notes: source note: aiza isia kalala supah a lasvi=an. 比較正確的順序。supah-an kasu sui. 你很多錢。supah isu sui 你的錢很多。aiza isia kalala(=cia) supah lasvi。

S.FORM: pan'utung saia sadu tu at aiza isia kalala lasvian supahan.
S.PHON: panʔutuŋ saia sadu tu at aiða iɕia ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a [l|ɬ]asvian supa[x|χ]an
S.FORM: pan'utung saia sadu tu at aiza isia kalala lasvian supahan.
S.PHON: panʔutuŋ saia sadu tu at aiða iɕia ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a [l|ɬ]asvian supa[x|χ]an
S.TRANSL: 他停下來,看到籃子有很多梨子.
He stopped, seeing so many pears in baskets.

S.FORM: sadu saia tu aiza idadaza madaingaz matatapul a.
S.PHON: sadu saia tu aiða idadaða madaiŋað matatapu[l|ɬ] a
S.FORM: sadu saia tu aiza idadaza madaingaz matatapul a.
S.PHON: sadu saia tu aiða idadaða madaiŋað matatapu[l|ɬ] a
S.TRANSL: 他看到一個老人在[樹]上面一直採.
He sees that there is an old man plucking.

S.FORM: miliskin saia tu nasiza tu tasa.
S.PHON: mi[l|ɬ]iskin saia tu naɕiða tu tasa
S.FORM: miliskin saia tu nasiza tu tasa.
S.PHON: mi[l|ɬ]iskin saia tu naɕiða tu tasa
S.TRANSL: 他想說要拿一顆.
He wants to take one piece.

S.FORM: ana tan a maun.
S.PHON: ana tan a maun
S.FORM: ana tan a maun.
S.PHON: ana tan a maun
S.TRANSL: 試吃.
To try it.

S.FORM: at sahnaan saicia madaignaza sadu tu adu nasadu saicia.
S.PHON: at sa[x|χ]naan saiʨia madai*naða sadu tu adu nasadu saiʨia
S.FORM: at sahnaan saicia madaignaza sadu tu adu nasadu saicia.
S.PHON: at sa[x|χ]naan saiʨia madai*naða sadu tu adu nasadu saiʨia
S.TRANSL: 他再看看那個老人家有沒有看到他.
He looks again to see if the old man has seen him.

FORM.notes: source note: la-haib seems to be a compositional verb, but I couldn’t find a special meaning for la

S.FORM: nii tu sadu i aupa maza madaingaza hai malmananu matatapul nii tu haiap tu aiza bunun inastu lahahaib.
S.PHON: nii tu sadu i aupa maða madaiŋaða [x|χ]ai ma[l|ɬ]mananu matatapu[l|ɬ] nii tu [x|χ]aiap tu aiða bunun inastu [l|ɬ]a[x|χ]a[x|χ]aib
S.FORM: nii tu sadu i aupa maza madaingaza hai malmananu matatapul nii tu haiap tu aiza bunun inastu lahahaib.
S.PHON: nii tu sadu i aupa maða madaiŋaða [x|χ]ai ma[l|ɬ]mananu matatapu[l|ɬ] nii tu [x|χ]aiap tu aiða bunun inastu [l|ɬ]a[x|χ]a[x|χ]aib
S.TRANSL: 沒有看到,因為那個老人很努力抑制採摘,不知道有一個人在地下有人經過
He hasn't, because the old man is plucking industriously, he doesn't know there is somebody passing by below.

FORM.notes: source note: iahai similar to DAU

S.FORM: maza uvaaza hai miliskin tu at nii a madaingaza hai haiap at antabanun tu iahai tas tu kalalain.
S.PHON: maða uvaaða [x|χ]ai mi[l|ɬ]iskin tu at nii a madaiŋaða [x|χ]ai [x|χ]aiap at antabanun tu ia[x|χ]ai tas tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]ain
S.FORM: maza uvaaza hai miliskin tu at nii a madaingaza hai haiap at antabanun tu iahai tas tu kalalain.
S.PHON: maða uvaaða [x|χ]ai mi[l|ɬ]iskin tu at nii a madaiŋaða [x|χ]ai [x|χ]aiap at antabanun tu ia[x|χ]ai tas tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]ain
S.TRANSL: 那個孩子想說,反正老人不知道,乾脆拿走一個算了.
The child thought to himself, the old man wouldn't know if I took away one basket.

S.FORM: maupacia tu mudaan saia.
S.PHON: maupaʨia tu mudaan saia
S.FORM: maupacia tu mudaan saia.
S.PHON: maupaʨia tu mudaan saia
S.TRANSL: 他就這樣走了.
Then he went on his way.

S.FORM: madas tu tas tu kalala tuntanpu.
S.PHON: madas tu tas tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a tuntanpu
S.FORM: madas tu tas tu kalala tuntanpu.
S.PHON: madas tu tas tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a tuntanpu
S.TRANSL: 他帶了一籃子騎單車走了.
He took one basket and biked away.

S.FORM: madaingaza hai maldauk tu idadaza lukiscia matatapul.
S.PHON: madaiŋaða [x|χ]ai ma[l|ɬ]dauk tu idadaða [l|ɬ]ukisʨia matatapu[l|ɬ]
S.FORM: madaingaza hai maldauk tu idadaza lukiscia matatapul.
S.PHON: madaiŋaða [x|χ]ai ma[l|ɬ]dauk tu idadaða [l|ɬ]ukisʨia matatapu[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: 那個老人仍然在樹上一直採.
The old man was still harvesting in the tree.

FORM.notes: source note: madiskav < mabiskav 快速地動

S.FORM: at mudaan uvaaza madiskav tuntanpu i aupa binis inhaiapus madaingazcia hai nasinapun.
S.PHON: at mudaan uvaaða madiskav tuntanpu i aupa binis in[x|χ]aiapus madaiŋaðʨia [x|χ]ai naɕinapun
S.FORM: at mudaan uvaaza madiskav tuntanpu i aupa binis inhaiapus madaingazcia hai nasinapun.
S.PHON: at mudaan uvaaða madiskav tuntanpu i aupa binis in[x|χ]aiapus madaiŋaðʨia [x|χ]ai naɕinapun
S.TRANSL: 然後那個孩子就騎著單車快速地跑了,因為萬一被那個老人知道他會被追的.
Then the child quickly rode away on his bike just in the case he was going to be chased once the old man knew.

FORM.notes: source note: mi-kua 怎麼？發生什麼事？ma-kua 怎麼樣？

S.FORM: aiza amin tu tasa uvaaz maupacia amin tu tuntanpu at namaikakuadau saia.
S.PHON: aiða amin tu tasa uvaað maupaʨia amin tu tuntanpu at namaikakuadau saia
S.FORM: aiza amin tu tasa uvaaz maupacia amin tu tuntanpu at namaikakuadau saia.
S.PHON: aiða amin tu tasa uvaað maupaʨia amin tu tuntanpu at namaikakuadau saia
S.TRANSL: 還有另一個孩子也是騎單車,好像是要去哪裡.
There was another kid also riding a bike like that, looking like went toward somewhere.

W.TRANSL: 非實現=朝向<重疊>如何=知識詞

S.FORM: pa makuang a daana batubatu hai.
S.PHON: pa makuaŋ a daana batubatu [x|χ]ai
S.FORM: pa makuang a daana batubatu hai.
S.PHON: pa makuaŋ a daana batubatu [x|χ]ai
S.TRANSL: 石頭路不好.
The stone road was bad.

FORM.notes: source note: 女生binanauaz 漂亮 manauaz。男生minduduaz 帥 talmandu。talnahtung20幾歲 talutpu 40以上。maimi-kakua 講錯了，應該是maikakua

S.FORM: milisikin a minduduaz uvaazan tu bananaz uvaazan tu ai namaimikakuabis minanauazan i a adu miliskin saia tu ai manauaz tu binanauaz hai.
S.PHON: mi[l|ɬ]iɕikin a minduduað uvaaðan tu bananað uvaaðan tu ai namaimikakuabis minanauaðan i a adu mi[l|ɬ]iskin saia tu ai manauað tu binanauað [x|χ]ai
S.FORM: milisikin a minduduaz uvaazan tu bananaz uvaazan tu ai namaimikakuabis minanauazan i a adu miliskin saia tu ai manauaz tu binanauaz hai.
S.PHON: mi[l|ɬ]iɕikin a minduduað uvaaðan tu bananað uvaaðan tu ai namaimikakuabis minanauaðan i a adu mi[l|ɬ]iskin saia tu ai manauað tu binanauað [x|χ]ai
S.TRANSL: 那個年輕人在想女生到底要往哪裡?他覺得:＂哇!很漂亮的女生!＂
The young boy was thinking where the pretty girl was going to. He thought the girl is so beautiful.

W.TRANSL: 非實現=朝向-<重疊>如何=到底=斜格

S.FORM: sakakiivan saicia sadu at nii tu haiap tu aiza hangsia batudaingaz itanangaus.
S.PHON: sakakiivan saiʨia sadu at nii tu [x|χ]aiap tu aiða [x|χ]aŋɕia batudaiŋað itanaŋaus
S.FORM: sakakiivan saicia sadu at nii tu haiap tu aiza hangsia batudaingaz itanangaus.
S.PHON: sakakiivan saiʨia sadu at nii tu [x|χ]aiap tu aiða [x|χ]aŋɕia batudaiŋað itanaŋaus
S.TRANSL: 他回頭看,不知道前面有石頭.
He looked back, not knowing there was a stone on his way front.

FORM.notes: source note: pap-tuh 撞（到頭） or pat-nung 碰撞到。這一句應該是講錯了，應該是和下一句合起來 pan-uni

S.FORM: pat uni a maza tanpu aupa mahusbu a itanangaus hai pancingkul.
S.PHON: pat uni a maða tanpu aupa ma[x|χ]usbu a itanaŋaus [x|χ]ai panʨiŋku[l|ɬ]
S.FORM: pat uni a maza tanpu aupa mahusbu a itanangaus hai pancingkul.
S.PHON: pat uni a maða tanpu aupa ma[x|χ]usbu a itanaŋaus [x|χ]ai panʨiŋku[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: 因為石頭很重,所以腳踏車撞到後倒了.
Because of the heavy stone, the bike hit it and fell down.

S.FORM: at panuni a isaicia bantas.
S.PHON: at panuni a isaiʨia bantas
S.FORM: at panuni a isaicia bantas.
S.PHON: at panuni a isaiʨia bantas
S.TRANSL: 他的腳也撞傷了.
His leg also got hurt.

FORM.notes: source note: saicia類詞的重音，如果是單一代詞 (saicia)就會是saicia，如果是那個水 saicia tu danum，是詞彙間的intonation的改變，影響到單字的發音。hangsia <- sia 原來如此。

S.FORM: pancingkul saia idii masasamsam isaicia tu bantas nii tu haiap tu aizaangsia uvaaz amin is itandingalancin mapahainan sadu saicia tu mucinkul.
S.PHON: panʨiŋku[l|ɬ] saia idii masasamsam isaiʨia tu bantas nii tu [x|χ]aiap tu aiðaaŋɕia uvaað amin is itandiŋa[l|ɬ]anʨin mapa[x|χ]ainan sadu saiʨia tu muʨinku[l|ɬ]
S.FORM: pancingkul saia idii masasamsam isaicia tu bantas nii tu haiap tu aizaangsia uvaaz amin is itandingalancin mapahainan sadu saicia tu mucinkul.
S.PHON: panʨiŋku[l|ɬ] saia idii masasamsam isaiʨia tu bantas nii tu [x|χ]aiap tu aiðaaŋɕia uvaað amin is itandiŋa[l|ɬ]anʨin mapa[x|χ]ainan sadu saiʨia tu muʨinku[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: 他撞倒在那裡,一直揉他的腳,不知道還有其他小孩也在旁邊玩耍,看到他跌倒
He fell down there, keeping rubbing his foot, not knowing there existed other kids playing around and seeing him tripping over.

FORM.notes: source note: adus < adu=mas 或者的感覺

S.FORM: aupa uvaaza hai miliskin tu ai makaskas adii mabananaz uvaazan i at macingmut at maupacia tu at mindangaz aupas madaingaz at masatu tas tu kalala tusia lasvicin adu isbaliv adus napulumahun.
S.PHON: aupa uvaaða [x|χ]ai mi[l|ɬ]iskin tu ai makaskas adii mabananað uvaaðan i at maʨiŋmut at maupaʨia tu at mindaŋað aupas madaiŋað at masatu tas tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a tuɕia [l|ɬ]asviʨin adu isba[l|ɬ]iv adus napu[l|ɬ]uma[x|χ]un
S.FORM: aupa uvaaza hai miliskin tu ai makaskas adii mabananaz uvaazan i at macingmut at maupacia tu at mindangaz aupas madaingaz at masatu tas tu kalala tusia lasvicin adu isbaliv adus napulumahun.
S.PHON: aupa uvaaða [x|χ]ai mi[l|ɬ]iskin tu ai makaskas adii mabananað uvaaðan i at maʨiŋmut at maupaʨia tu at mindaŋað aupas madaiŋað at masatu tas tu ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]a tuɕia [l|ɬ]asviʨin adu isba[l|ɬ]iv adus napu[l|ɬ]uma[x|χ]un
S.TRANSL: 然後那個孩子在想:＂欸?這個男孩子很勤勞,怎麼那麼早幫老人家運送一籃的梨子去賣還是帶回家.＂
The kid was thinking 'Well, this boy was so diligent in getting up early like that to help the elder to take a basket of pears to sell or back home! '

FORM.notes: source note: kansuhaisun kantundah 踢回去。mapin is wrong, should be mindia

S.FORM: at pancinkul hai indangazan naicia ma mapin mindia masuhis punsia kalalacia.
S.PHON: at panʨinku[l|ɬ] [x|χ]ai indaŋaðan naiʨia ma mapin mindia masu[x|χ]is punɕia ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]aʨia
S.FORM: at pancinkul hai indangazan naicia ma mapin mindia masuhis punsia kalalacia.
S.PHON: at panʨinku[l|ɬ] [x|χ]ai indaŋaðan naiʨia ma mapin mindia masu[x|χ]is punɕia ka[l|ɬ]a[l|ɬ]aʨia
S.TRANSL: 他們就幫那撞倒的孩子撿起來放到籃子裡.
They helped the tripped kid pick and put back into the basket.

S.FORM: at aupa maupacia naia tu mudaanin tuntanpu amin uvaaza tantatau naia mudaan at.
S.PHON: at aupa maupaʨia naia tu mudaanin tuntanpu amin uvaaða tantatau naia mudaan at
